passages.text: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia, a message was revealed to Daniel, who was called Belteshazzar. The message was true, and it concerned a great conflict. And the understanding of the message was given to him in a vision.
passages.sermon:
Cyrus was the king of Persia.
This was the third year of his reign.
Daniel received a message at that time.
People also called Daniel by the name Belteshazzar.
The message was true.
The message was about a great conflict.
Daniel understood the message.
He received understanding through a vision.
passages.original: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שָׁל֗וֹשׁ לְכ֙וֹרֶשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס דָּבָר֙ נִגְלָ֣ה לְדָֽנִיֵּ֔אל אֲשֶׁר־ נִקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּ֑ר וֶאֱמֶ֤ת הַדָּבָר֙ וְצָבָ֣א גָד֔וֹל וּבִין֙ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֔ר וּבִ֥ינָה ל֖וֹ בַּמַּרְאֶֽה׃

passages.text: In those days I, Daniel, was mourning for three full weeks.
passages.sermon:
Daniel was a prophet.
Daniel lived during the time of Cyrus, king of Persia.
God gave Daniel visions and understanding.
During those days, Daniel mourned.
Daniel mourned for three weeks.
Daniel mourned for twenty-one days.
passages.original: בַּיָּמִ֖ים הָהֵ֑ם אֲנִ֤י דָֽנִיֵּאל֙ הָיִ֣יתִי מִתְאַבֵּ֔ל שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה שָׁבֻעִ֖ים יָמִֽים׃

passages.text: I ate no rich food, no meat or wine entered my mouth, and I did not anoint myself with oil until the three weeks were completed.
passages.sermon:
Daniel was a prophet of God.
Daniel lived during the reign of Cyrus, king of Persia.
Daniel mourned for three weeks.
During these three weeks, Daniel did not eat any rich food.
Daniel did not eat meat.
Daniel did not drink wine.
Daniel did not anoint himself with oil.
Daniel kept this fast until the full three weeks were finished.
passages.original: לֶ֣חֶם חֲמֻד֞וֹת לֹ֣א אָכַ֗לְתִּי וּבָשָׂ֥ר וָיַ֛יִן לֹא־ בָ֥א אֶל־ פִּ֖י וְס֣וֹךְ לֹא־ סָ֑כְתִּי עַד־ מְלֹ֕את שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת שָׁבֻעִ֖ים יָמִֽים׃פ

passages.text: On the twenty-fourth day of the first month, as I was standing on the bank of the great river, the Tigris, I lifted up my eyes, and behold, there was a certain man dressed in linen, with a belt of fine gold from Uphaz around his waist.
passages.sermon:
Daniel was a prophet of God.
On the twenty-fourth day of the first month, Daniel stood by the great river.
This river was the Tigris.
Daniel lifted up his eyes.
He saw a man.
This man wore linen clothes.
He had a belt of fine gold from Uphaz around his waist.
passages.original: וּבְי֛וֹם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן וַאֲנִ֗י הָיִ֛יתִי עַ֣ל יַ֧ד הַנָּהָ֛ר הַגָּד֖וֹל ה֥וּא חִדָּֽקֶל׃ וָאֶשָּׂ֤א אֶת־ עֵינַי֙ וָאֵ֔רֶא וְהִנֵּ֥ה אִישׁ־ אֶחָ֖ד לָב֣וּשׁ בַּדִּ֑ים וּמָתְנָ֥יו חֲגֻרִ֖ים בְּכֶ֥תֶם אוּפָֽז׃

passages.text: His body was like beryl, his face like the brilliance of lightning, his eyes like flaming torches, his arms and legs like the gleam of polished bronze, and his voice like the sound of a multitude.
passages.sermon:
Daniel saw a man in a vision.
The man's body looked like beryl.
His face shone as bright as lightning.
His eyes looked like flaming torches.
His arms and legs gleamed like polished bronze.
His voice sounded like the roar of a great crowd.
passages.original: וּגְוִיָּת֣וֹ כְתַרְשִׁ֗ישׁ וּפָנָ֞יו כְּמַרְאֵ֤ה בָרָק֙ וְעֵינָיו֙ כְּלַפִּ֣ידֵי אֵ֔שׁ וּזְרֹֽעֹתָיו֙ וּמַרְגְּלֹתָ֔יו כְּעֵ֖ין נְחֹ֣שֶׁת קָלָ֑ל וְק֥וֹל דְּבָרָ֖יו כְּק֥וֹל הָמֽוֹן׃

passages.text: Only I, Daniel, saw the vision; the men with me did not see it, but a great terror fell upon them, and they ran and hid themselves.
passages.sermon:
I am Daniel.
I saw the vision.
The men were with me.
The men did not see the vision.
A great terror fell on the men.
The men ran away.
The men hid themselves.
passages.original: וְרָאִיתִי֩ אֲנִ֨י דָנִיֵּ֤אל לְבַדִּי֙ אֶת־ הַמַּרְאָ֔ה וְהָאֲנָשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֣וּ עִמִּ֔י לֹ֥א רָא֖וּ אֶת־ הַמַּרְאָ֑ה אֲבָ֗ל חֲרָדָ֤ה גְדֹלָה֙ נָפְלָ֣ה עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וַֽיִּבְרְח֖וּ בְּהֵחָבֵֽא׃

passages.text: So I was left alone, gazing at this great vision. No strength remained in me; my face grew deathly pale, and I was powerless.
passages.sermon:
Daniel was a prophet of God.
Daniel saw a great vision.
Daniel was alone.
No one else saw the vision with him.
Daniel looked at the vision.
Daniel lost all his strength.
Daniel’s face became very pale.
Daniel had no power left in him.
passages.original: וַאֲנִי֙ נִשְׁאַ֣רְתִּי לְבַדִּ֔י וָֽאֶרְאֶ֗ה אֶת־ הַמַּרְאָ֤ה הַגְּדֹלָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את וְלֹ֥א נִשְׁאַר־ בִּ֖י כֹּ֑ח וְהוֹדִ֗י נֶהְפַּ֤ךְ עָלַי֙ לְמַשְׁחִ֔ית וְלֹ֥א עָצַ֖רְתִּי כֹּֽחַ׃

passages.text: I heard the sound of his words, and as I listened, I fell into a deep sleep, with my face to the ground.
passages.sermon:
Daniel was a prophet of God.
Daniel saw a great vision.
Daniel was alone.
Daniel heard the sound of the angel’s words.
Daniel listened to the angel’s voice.
Daniel fell into a deep sleep.
Daniel’s face was toward the ground.
passages.original: וָאֶשְׁמַ֖ע אֶת־ ק֣וֹל דְּבָרָ֑יו וּכְשָׁמְעִי֙ אֶת־ ק֣וֹל דְּבָרָ֔יו וַאֲנִ֗י הָיִ֛יתִי נִרְדָּ֥ם עַל־ פָּנַ֖י וּפָנַ֥י אָֽרְצָה׃

passages.text: Suddenly, a hand touched me and set me trembling on my hands and knees.
passages.sermon:
Daniel was a prophet of God.
\r\nDaniel saw a great vision.
\r\nDaniel was left alone.
\r\nDaniel lost all his strength.
\r\nDaniel’s face became pale.
\r\nDaniel was powerless.
\r\nSuddenly, a hand touched Daniel.
\r\nThe hand made Daniel tremble.
\r\nDaniel was set on his hands and knees.
passages.original: וְהִנֵּה־ יָ֖ד נָ֣גְעָה בִּ֑י וַתְּנִיעֵ֥נִי עַל־ בִּרְכַּ֖י וְכַפּ֥וֹת יָדָֽי׃

passages.text: He said to me, “Daniel, you are a man who is highly precious. Consider carefully the words that I am about to say to you. Stand up, for I have now been sent to you.” And when he had said this to me, I stood up trembling.
passages.sermon:
An angel spoke to Daniel.
Daniel was a man who was highly precious to God.
The angel said, “Daniel, listen carefully to my words.
I am speaking to you now.
Stand up on your feet.
I have been sent to you at this moment.”
When the angel spoke these words to me, I stood up.
I was trembling.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֡י דָּנִיֵּ֣אל אִישׁ־ חֲ֠מֻדוֹת הָבֵ֨ן בַּדְּבָרִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר֩ אָנֹכִ֨י דֹבֵ֤ר אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ וַעֲמֹ֣ד עַל־ עָמְדֶ֔ךָ כִּ֥י עַתָּ֖ה שֻׁלַּ֣חְתִּי אֵלֶ֑יךָ וּבְדַבְּר֥וֹ עִמִּ֛י אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה עָמַ֥דְתִּי מַרְעִֽיד׃

passages.text: “Do not be afraid, Daniel,” he said, “for from the first day that you purposed to understand and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard, and I have come in response to them.
passages.sermon:
A messenger spoke to Daniel.
He said, “Do not be afraid, Daniel.
From the first day you set your heart to understand, your words were heard.
From the first day you humbled yourself before your God, your words were heard.
I have come because of your words.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַי֮ אַל־ תִּירָ֣א דָנִיֵּאל֒ כִּ֣י׀ מִן־ הַיּ֣וֹם הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧תָּ אֶֽת־ לִבְּךָ֛ לְהָבִ֧ין וּלְהִתְעַנּ֛וֹת לִפְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נִשְׁמְע֣וּ דְבָרֶ֑יךָ וַאֲנִי־ בָ֖אתִי בִּדְבָרֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: However, the prince of the kingdom of Persia opposed me for twenty-one days. Then Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me, for I had been left there with the kings of Persia.
passages.sermon:
The prince of the kingdom of Persia opposed me.
He stood against me for twenty-one days.
Michael is one of the chief princes.
Michael came to help me.
I had been left there with the kings of Persia.
passages.original: וְשַׂ֣ר׀ מַלְכ֣וּת פָּרַ֗ס עֹמֵ֤ד לְנֶגְדִּי֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְאֶחָ֣ד י֔וֹם וְהִנֵּ֣ה מִֽיכָאֵ֗ל אַחַ֛ד הַשָּׂרִ֥ים הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים בָּ֣א לְעָזְרֵ֑נִי וַאֲנִי֙ נוֹתַ֣רְתִּי שָׁ֔ם אֵ֖צֶל מַלְכֵ֥י פָרָֽס׃

passages.text: Now I have come to explain to you what will happen to your people in the latter days, for the vision concerns those days.”
passages.sermon:
A heavenly messenger spoke to Daniel.
The messenger said, “I have come to help you understand.
I will explain what will happen to your people in the last days.
This vision is about the future.
The vision concerns the days to come.”
passages.original: וּבָ֙אתִי֙ לַהֲבִ֣ינְךָ֔ אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־ יִקְרָ֥ה לְעַמְּךָ֖ בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַיָּמִ֑ים כִּי־ ע֥וֹד חָז֖וֹן לַיָּמִֽים׃

passages.text: While he was speaking these words to me, I set my face toward the ground and became speechless.
passages.sermon: A heavenly messenger spoke these words to me.\r\nI looked down at the ground.\r\nI could not speak.
passages.original: וּבְדַבְּר֣וֹ עִמִּ֔י כַּדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה נָתַ֧תִּי פָנַ֛י אַ֖רְצָה וְנֶאֱלָֽמְתִּי׃

passages.text: And suddenly one with the likeness of a man touched my lips, and I opened my mouth and said to the one standing before me, “My lord, because of the vision, I am overcome with anguish, and I have no strength.
passages.sermon:
A figure appeared before me.
He looked like a man.
He touched my lips.
I opened my mouth.
I spoke to the one standing in front of me.
I said, “My lord, the vision has overwhelmed me.
I am filled with anguish.
I have no strength.”
passages.original: וְהִנֵּ֗ה כִּדְמוּת֙ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם נֹגֵ֖עַ עַל־ שְׂפָתָ֑י וָאֶפְתַּח־ פִּ֗י וָאֲדַבְּרָה֙ וָאֹֽמְרָה֙ אֶל־ הָעֹמֵ֣ד לְנֶגְדִּ֔י אֲדֹנִ֗י בַּמַּרְאָה֙ נֶהֶפְכ֤וּ צִירַי֙ עָלַ֔י וְלֹ֥א עָצַ֖רְתִּי כֹּֽחַ׃

passages.text: How can I, your servant, speak with you, my lord? Now I have no strength, nor is any breath left in me.”
passages.sermon:
Daniel is the speaker.
Daniel is a servant.
Daniel speaks to a figure he calls "my lord."
Daniel says, "How can I, your servant, speak with you, my lord?"
Daniel says, "Now I have no strength."
Daniel says, "No breath remains in me."
passages.original: וְהֵ֣יךְ יוּכַ֗ל עֶ֤בֶד אֲדֹנִי֙ זֶ֔ה לְדַבֵּ֖ר עִם־ אֲדֹ֣נִי זֶ֑ה וַאֲנִ֤י מֵעַ֙תָּה֙ לֹֽא־ יַעֲמָד־ בִּ֣י כֹ֔חַ וּנְשָׁמָ֖ה לֹ֥א נִשְׁאֲרָה־ בִֽי׃

passages.text: Again the one with the likeness of a man touched me and strengthened me.
passages.sermon:
A being appeared before me.
This being looked like a man.
He touched me again.
He gave me strength.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֧סֶף וַיִּגַּע־ בִּ֛י כְּמַרְאֵ֥ה אָדָ֖ם וַֽיְחַזְּקֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: “Do not be afraid, you who are highly precious,” he said. “Peace be with you! Be strong now; be very strong!” As he spoke with me, I was strengthened and said, “Speak, my lord, for you have strengthened me.”
passages.sermon:
A man who looked like a human spoke to Daniel.
He said, “Do not be afraid.”
He called Daniel “highly precious.”
He said, “Peace be with you.”
He said, “Be strong.”
He said, “Be very strong.”
As the man spoke, Daniel became stronger.
Daniel said, “Speak, my lord.”
Daniel said, “You have strengthened me.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֜אמֶר אַל־ תִּירָ֧א אִישׁ־ חֲמֻד֛וֹת שָׁל֥וֹם לָ֖ךְ חֲזַ֣ק וַחֲזָ֑ק וּֽבְדַבְּר֤וֹ עִמִּי֙ הִתְחַזַּ֔קְתִּי וָאֹֽמְרָ֛ה יְדַבֵּ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖י כִּ֥י חִזַּקְתָּֽנִי׃

passages.text: “Do you know why I have come to you?” he said. “I must return at once to fight against the prince of Persia, and when I have gone forth, behold, the prince of Greece will come.
passages.sermon:
A man who looked like a human spoke to me.
He said, “Do you know why I have come to you?”
He said, “I must return now.”
He said, “I will fight against the prince of Persia.”
He said, “When I go, the prince of Greece will come.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הֲיָדַ֙עְתָּ֙ לָמָּה־ בָּ֣אתִי אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְעַתָּ֣ה אָשׁ֔וּב לְהִלָּחֵ֖ם עִם־ שַׂ֣ר פָּרָ֑ס וַאֲנִ֣י יוֹצֵ֔א וְהִנֵּ֥ה שַׂר־ יָוָ֖ן בָּֽא׃

passages.text: But first I will tell you what is inscribed in the Book of Truth. Yet no one has the courage to support me against these, except Michael your prince.
passages.sermon: I will tell you what is written in the Book of Truth.\r\nNo one stands with me against these forces.\r\nOnly Michael, your prince, supports me.
passages.original: אֲבָל֙ אַגִּ֣יד לְךָ֔ אֶת־ הָרָשׁ֥וּם בִּכְתָ֖ב אֱמֶ֑ת וְאֵ֨ין אֶחָ֜ד מִתְחַזֵּ֤ק עִמִּי֙ עַל־ אֵ֔לֶּה כִּ֥י אִם־ מִיכָאֵ֖ל שַׂרְכֶֽם׃פ
